title: Notice of Intended Modification of Transmission Licence No. ERA/LIC/TX/025/236 issued to Amari Power Transmission SMC Limited
text:
PUBLIC NOTICE
INTENDED MODIFICATION OF TRANSMISSION
LICENCE NO. ERA/LIC/TX/025/236 ISSUED TO AMARI
POWER TRANSMISSION SMC LIMITED
Under Section 44 (5) of the Electricity Act, Cap. 157.
Pursuant to its powers under Section 44 (4) of the Electricity Act, Cap. 157, the
Electricity Regulatory Authority HEREBY GIVES NOTICE that, in line with Section
44 (5), it intends to modify Transmission Licence No. ERA/LIC/TX/025/236,
issued to Amari Power Transmission SMC Limited, for the construction and
ownership of Transmission Facilities in Tororo, Mbarara North, Mbarara South,
and Nkenda, by extending the project implementation timelines, including
the Financial Close, Construction Start Date, and Commercial Operations
Date.
In line with Section 44 (5) of the Electricity Act, Cap. 157, the public is
invited to submit to the Authority any representations and/or objections in
respect of the intended modifi cation within thirty (30) days from the date
of publication of this notice.
Submissions should be made in writing to the Secretary of the Authority via
email (secretary@era.go.ug or era.registry@era.go.ug) or by hand delivery
at the address below.
Dated 23rrdd December, 2025
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
ELECTRICITY REGULATORY AUTHORITY
ERA House, Plot 5C - 1, 3rd Street - Lugogo, Industrial Area | P.O. Box 10332, Kampala - Uganda
Website: www.era.go.ug | Email: info@era.go.ug | Tel: +256 393 260166 | WhatsApp: +256 776 188 188
